ratios.quote: At March 31, 2026, our leverage ratio was 1.71 to 1.0, which meets the requirement of not being above 3 to 1.

parsed.notes: The same covenant disclosure appears in both the notes and MD&A, so it is reported once. The filing does not say whether the leverage ratio is total or net; total_leverage is assumed. The leverage ratio also sets the margin and fee grid, but it is reported here only as the covenant.
